tool_args.rationale: The pilot rows show short-horizon positive gain, but cannot calibrate the slow adaptation term or confirm the predicted sign reversal at long horizons. The provided guidance specifically recommends the slow-horizon discriminating probe first.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit four-parameter dual-exponential model from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations are at H≤0.48, so they do not identify the slow component or verify reversal near the target horizon H=24.3.
More short-window trajectory data would not resolve the stated long-horizon identifiability gap.
It is irrelevant to the specified horizon-dependent mechanism and is explicitly not worth acquiring.
